en: Guided by the Crossbone Vanguard
Sparkling Beginner Gina Departure -

From "Mobile Suit Gundam F91", which has reached its 30th theatrical release, Begina Gina, piloted by Bella Rona, is now available in the RE/100 series as a special specification model with extra finish processing!
A special item with a form mainly composed of curved surfaces that creates a profound and glittering look!
● COATING
The light gray part, which is the main part of the exterior, has been given an extra finish to give it a luxurious feel.
●METALLIC
The impressive chest, fins, nozzles, etc. are purple in color, and the weapons have a metallic color that gives off a metallic feel.
Attached weapons: Beam Rifle / Beam Saber / Beam Launcher / Beam Seal
